faq_heading: Homes near Coast Meridian Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Coast Meridian Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Coast Meridian Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Coast Meridian Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Coast Meridian Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 42 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,410,000, townhomes $850,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Coast Meridian Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Coast Meridian Elementary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 2% of sales above the list price for the 42 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Coast Meridian Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are William Watson Elementary (1.0 km south-west), Gobind Sarvar School (1.2 km north) and Walnut Road Elementary (1.4 km west).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Coast Meridian Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Coast Meridian Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Coast Meridian Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Coast Meridian Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 42 homes sold within 1 km of Coast Meridian Elementary: 23 houses, 15 townhomes and 4 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,410,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Coast Meridian Elementary

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Coast Meridian Elementary in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 other, 2 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is William Watson Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Serpentine Heights Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Holy Cross Regional High School (1.9 km); the nearest independent school is Gobind Sarvar School (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: William Watson Elementary (1.0 km south-west), Walnut Road Elementary (1.4 km west), Frost Road Elementary (1.5 km north-west), St Matthew's Elementary (2.0 km north-west), Coyote Creek Elementary (2.6 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is William Watson Elementary, 1.0 km south-west of Coast Meridian Elementary.
